fnol_text: My name is Bianca Al-Sayed and I live at 567 Maple Road, Milton, VT 05478. You can reach me on (555) 889-5373 or bianca.alsayed@example.com. On 17 March 2026 another car pulled out of a side road and hit my front passenger side. The other driver, Owen Oyelaran, admitted they didn't see me. Policy MT-2024-00139. I'd like to claim for the damage to my car.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mrs Al-Sayed on (555) 889-5373 to acknowledge the claim. Bianca confirmed the loss date as 17 March 2026.
Vehicle inspected at the repairer. Witness Samuel Achebe gave a statement by phone.
Third-party driver Owen Oyelaran reports a mild concussion and attended County General. Bianca reports minor burns to the hand.
